name: Advanced Web Architecture & React
description: Deep-dive into component lifecycle, high-performance state management, Vite bundlers, single-page application architectures, and client-side caching.
syllabus: Week 1-3: Modern React 19 Paradigms, Virtual DOM & Hooks internals
Week 4-6: State Management, Context API & LocalStorage synchronization
Week 7-9: Client Routing, Code Splitting & Performance Profiling
Week 10-14: External REST APIs, Gemini AI Integration & Production Deployments

name: Database Management Systems & SQL
description: Relational calculus, Boyce-Codd normal forms, ACID transaction semantics, indexing B-trees, query optimization, and NoSQL document architectures.
syllabus: Week 1-3: Relational Data Modeling & ER Diagrams
Week 4-6: Advanced SQL Joins, Triggers, and Stored Procedures
Week 7-9: Database Normalization (1NF through BCNF)
Week 10-14: Transaction Concurrency, Locking, and Document Stores

name: Computer Networks & Security Protocols
description: OSI 7-Layer reference, TCP/IP socket programming, subnetting, routing algorithms, public-key cryptography, SSL/TLS, and modern cyber threats.
syllabus: Week 1-3: Network Topologies & Data Link Layer Protocols
Week 4-6: IP Subnetting, CIDR, and Distance-Vector Routing
Week 7-9: Transport Layer (TCP vs UDP Congestion Controls)
Week 10-14: Asymmetric Cryptography, TLS 1.3, and Firewall Rules

name: Software Engineering & Agile Methodology
description: Software development lifecycles, Scrum rituals, sprint planning, UML modeling, clean code architecture, CI/CD automated testing pipelines, and design patterns.
syllabus: Week 1-3: Requirement Engineering & User Stories Definition
Week 4-6: UML Class, Sequence, and Statechart Diagrams
Week 7-9: SOLID Principles & Gang-of-Four Design Patterns
Week 10-14: Test-Driven Development (TDD) & Scrum Sprint Releases

name: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
description: Foundations of modern AI: heuristic search, supervised vs unsupervised learning, gradient descent, deep neural networks, and prompt engineering with Large Language Models.
syllabus: Week 1-3: A* Search, Minimax & Heuristic Optimization
Week 4-6: Linear Regression, Logistic Classification & Decision Trees
Week 7-9: Neural Networks Backpropagation & Convolutional Layers
Week 10-14: Transformer Architectures, LLM Integration & Gemini API

name: Cloud Computing & DevOps Practicum
description: Containerization using Docker, microservices orchestration, Infrastructure-as-Code, automated deployment pipelines, serverless functions, and cloud monitoring.
syllabus: Week 1-3: Virtualization vs Linux Containerization (Docker)
Week 4-6: Docker Compose Multi-Container Orchestration
Week 7-9: Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
Week 10-14: Cloud Monitoring, Service Meshes, and Serverless Functions
